questions.question: Whom does the LORD heal and care for in Psalm 147?
options: The wealthy rulers, increasing their riches
The brokenhearted, binding up their wounds
The proud nations, gathering them to Zion
The mighty warriors, arming them for battle
questions.answer: The brokenhearted, binding up their wounds

questions.question: What shows God's vast understanding in Psalm 147?
options: He measures the waters in the palm of his hand
He numbers the grains of sand on the shore
He weighs the mountains in a great balance
He counts the stars and calls them by name
questions.answer: He counts the stars and calls them by name

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him and hope in his steadfast love.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their _____.
He determines the number of the _____; he gives to all of them their names.
